# name	shell command	PowerShell command	description	parameters	high risk
cl	clear	Clear-Host	Clear the terminal	no	no
gad	git add .	git add .	Stage all changes in the current repository	no	yes
gcm	git commit -m	git commit -m	Create a commit with the supplied message	yes	no
gps	git push	git push	Push commits to the configured remote	no	yes
gpl	git pull	git pull	Pull and integrate changes from the configured remote	no	yes
gmg	git merge	git merge	Merge the supplied branch or ref	yes	yes
gst	git status	git status	Show working tree status	no	no
glg	git log	git log	Show commit history	no	no
gll	git log --oneline	git log --oneline	Show compact commit history	no	no
gcl	git clone	git clone	Clone a repository	yes	no
nrd	npm run dev	npm run dev	Run the current project's dev script	no	yes
nrb	npm run build	npm run build	Run the current project's build script	no	yes
